runs.decision: Increment DESIRED_STATE to control21 and make post-freeze freshness identity-based over each role's already-approved authoritative control/config blobs. Keep strict H1/H2 bootstrap and immutable semantic tuple. After freeze, unrelated main movement alone is not a stop; later-head visibility is limited to exact authoritative blob-identity verification and may not supply semantic content. Any changed or unverifiable relevant identity, or own-state/input CAS conflict, still checkpoints and defers newer semantics. Do not alter assignments, O_CHAT_PARALLEL, DOWNSTREAM_STATE, O_OPERATIONS, primary O, protected recovery, or platform scheduler.

method_plan.selected_plan: Use exact relevant-control identity as the post-freeze freshness fence so concurrent receipt churn no longer causes mutual semantic starvation, while preserving one-semantic-config-per-invocation and no newer-head semantics.
rejected_alternatives: change root acceptance or assignments to avoid validation

rollback.condition: If revision21 permits newer-head semantic consumption, misses a genuine relevant control/config change, violates CLEAN isolation, or continues after relevant identity is unverifiable, increment control and restore revision20's stricter stop semantics.
